purpose: Check video-marker offset stability before expanding Twente clips from 12 seconds to full-duration development data.
pose_backend: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Full, 33 landmarks, VIDEO mode

synchronization.correlation: mean absolute Pearson correlation across available pose-marker signals

full_duration_expansion_gate: Only STABLE_CONSTANT trials may use one fixed offset. POSSIBLE_LINEAR_DRIFT trials require a separately frozen linear correction. Other classes are not admitted automatically.
prohibitions: Do not use force initial-contact times to choose synchronization offsets.
Do not tune thresholds after inspecting forbidden subjects or external videos.
Do not overwrite prior 10-22 second artifacts or reports.
Do not interpret this audit as model-performance improvement.
